faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Range Rover TDV6 use?
faqLeft.a: The Range Rover TDV6 and SDV6 use a 3.0-litre V6 diesel engine, fitted across the L322 and L405 generations from 2001 to 2021. The SDV6 is a higher-output version of the same engine family.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Range Rover TDV6 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,400, for either the TDV6 or SDV6. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the TDV6 or the SDV6 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild TDV6 Range Rover engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, turbo and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild SDV6 Range Rover engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The SDV6 shares the same engine family as the TDV6, and we service it to the same standard with the same components replaced.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Range Rover TDV6 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Range Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Range Rover TDV6 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Range Rover TDV6 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
